description: This file contains unit tests for the CallLogHandler class, verifying its behavior in handling call log searches, permission checks, JSON parsing, filtering, pagination, and error handling within an Android application.

classes.name: CallLogHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of CallLogHandler in various scenarios related to call log search handling.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly responds with an error when permission to read call logs is not granted.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Ensures that invalid JSON input results in an appropriate error response.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_returnsCallLogs
methods.description: Verifies that valid search requests return the expected call log data.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withFilters
methods.description: Tests filtering parameters such as number, name, date, duration, and type in call log search.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withPagination
methods.description: Checks that pagination via limit and offset works correctly.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withDefaultParams
methods.description: Ensures that default parameters are correctly handled when input is null.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withNullFields
methods.description: Tests handling of call logs with null fields, verifying proper JSON serialization.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_clampsLimitAndOffsetBeforeSearch
methods.description: Verifies that limit and offset parameters are clamped to valid ranges before executing the search.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_mapsSearchFailuresToUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures that exceptions during search are mapped to a proper unavailable error.
